findings.title: Hardcoded volatile Cloud Run host has no config/drift guard despite admitted brittleness
findings.evidence: "connect-src 'self' https://www.google.com https://mpc2-prod-23-is5qnl632q-ue.a.run.app", and doc comment: "The host is the container's generated Cloud Run URL — stable across revisions, changes only if the sGTM container is ever recreated (this line must follow)."
findings.detail: Verified in worktree: host hardcoded in policy/1; doc comment admits fragility; no env/config indirection (only CSP_ENFORCE is env-driven). Mitigations: PR body lists under open questions; Sentry soak before prod flip would surface a changed-host violation (blocked beacon), so drift is catchable. Spec-sanctioned comment-only approach.
findings.recommended_fix: Accept as documented follow-up, or drive host from env/config with a drift test before any future container recreation.

findings.title: Regional Google pixel domains only partially allowlisted by the diff's own admission
findings.evidence: "img-src 'self' data: https://www.google.com https://www.facebook.com https://www.google.ie https://www.google.com.gh", and doc comment: "More regional domains (google.co.uk, …) will surface as visitors come from other countries — each is a one-line addition here."
findings.detail: Spec-sanctioned: briefing explicitly says regional domains will surface and each is a one-line addition to flag in the PR. Flagged in both doc comment and PR body follow-ups. Not a gap; intentional narrow-allowlist posture.
findings.recommended_fix: No change. Track remaining regional domains (google.co.uk, …) as a bead/issue per PR body.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: PASS
findings.evidence: Test asserts each of the 4 additions (5 tuples: run.app, google.ie, google.com.gh, gstatic, toolytics) bound to full directive line, string.contains + split-length=2 exactly-once, in BOTH nonce and empty-nonce branches; well-formedness guards (no trailing ';', no ';;', no '*', no 'unsafe-eval'). Ran make test-server: 1185 passed, 0 failures; 7/7 csp tests pass; client 107 pass.
findings.detail: P0=100%, P1=100%, overall=100%. Every allowlisted domain asserted in exactly its directive, exactly once, both branches. Optional hardening: negative assertions that the three rejected hosts (ecs.us-east-1.on.aws, bare 'properties', righttenantry.ie) stay absent.
findings.recommended_fix: None required. Optional: negative-assertion regression lock-in for the three investigated-and-rejected hosts.
